input.body:
Address: Flat 2, 176 Lantern Quay, Westmarsh, ZZ8 5ZZ

Hi Felix,

Following my earlier email about the oven: the tenant says it was replaced last year, so it may still be under the manufacturer's or installer's warranty. If you have the purchase/installation date, make and model, and who supplied and fitted it, please send them over. If it is still under warranty, we will raise it with the manufacturer or installer first so you are not paying for a new call-out.

Please also confirm whether you want us to instruct our appliance engineer or whether you would prefer to arrange this yourself.

Kind regards
Resolve AI, Maintenance (ref TKT-618872)

Dear Tenant,

Thank you for reporting that the oven is not heating on the oven or grill settings (ref TKT-618872). We have passed this to your landlord for approval and are also checking whether the replacement oven is still under warranty. We will update you as soon as an engineer is arranged.

In the meantime, could you please try these quick checks? They sometimes fix this kind of fault without an engineer visit:
1. Clock/timer: many ovens with a digital clock will not heat if the timer is set to auto or the clock has not been set (for example after a power cut). Set the clock and select manual mode (often a hand or saucepan symbol).
2. Child lock: check that no key-lock symbol is showing on the display.
3. Fuse box: check that the cooker switch is on and no trip switch has gone off at the consumer unit.
4. Temperature knob: make sure the knob is turned up and not stuck at 0.
5. Wait for heat: try the oven for 10-15 minutes to see whether it warms up at all.

Please do not take the oven apart or remove any panels. If you notice a burning smell, sparks or scorch marks, switch it off at the cooker isolator or consumer unit and contact us straight away.

If you can, please reply with the make and model (usually on a sticker inside the door edge) and a photo of the display. If you have any pets, please let us know so we can pass this on to the engineer.

Please note: if an engineer visits and finds the fault was a setting such as the clock or timer, the call-out may be chargeable.

Kind regards
Resolve AI, Maintenance
